items.text: A sparse solo record from Molina, released alongside a more conventional album with Magnolia Electric Co.
items.why: Pack: "In 2006, Molina released two more records: the sparse solo Let Me Go... and the more conventional Fading Trails". It says only the same year; "released alongside" suggests they came out together.

items.text: In 2005 Magnolia Electric Co. put out a live album, a studio album and an EP.
items.why: "first official release was a live album, Trials and Errors, followed by a studio album ... and an EP ... all released in 2005".

items.text: The next year Molina released two more records.
Let Me Go, Let Me Go, Let Me Go is the sparse solo record of the pair.
items.why: "the sparse solo Let Me Go, Let Me Go, Let Me Go" (repeats the hook).

items.text: Fading Trails, made with Magnolia Electric Co., is the more conventional of the two.
items.why: "the more conventional Fading Trails with Magnolia Electric Co.".

missed: Nothing more about this album is in the pack. The voice-alone-with-piano-or-guitar detail belongs to Pyramid, so leaving it out is right. Fading Trails being "culled from three separate sessions" was also left out, but it is about the other record.
